note: vespera_core: a type array null next to an allOf / anyOf / oneOf is kept when the members admit null through a nullable or type-less schema (not only an exact {type: null}; a oneOf with two null-admitting branches rejects it); x-* extension keys of the Paths, Responses and Callback objects are skipped on deserialize instead of failing the document or coming back as a bogus path / status; an OpenAPI 3.0.x version deserializes as 3.1.0, matching the 3.1 body shapes it is converted to. The multipart wire tests compare a digest of the uploaded bytes instead of only the length and the first and last byte.
